stories.summary: Preserve the dispatch cost log on merge and compute per-cell Claude spend
stories.description: The Claude dispatch's agent.log.raw (whose final result event carries total_cost_usd) lives in the story worktree, which the bench merge stub deletes; copy it out first, then sum review + dispatch spend per cell.
stories.agent_instructions:
Preflight: impact run 2026-10-01 on 9860e3e (scratch worktree, rough stand-ins for all seven BPM stories applied together) - 14076 passed / 21 skipped / 1 failed with AGENTS_DIR=agents/ as CI sets it. The one failure (tests/unit/test_remote_sync.py::test_ssh_run_raises_called_process_error_for_unreachable_host) is host-only: the preflight container has no ssh binary, and it fails identically on untouched master there. 0 conflicts with pre-existing tests. `ruff check .` clean (0.16.8); scripts/check_line_limit.py OK (tests/benchmark/harness.py 876 -> 886 lines). The tests/benchmark self-suite (NOT run by CI; pyproject addopts ignores tests/benchmark) has 18 pre-existing failures on master and none new.

TARGET IMPLEMENTER: cloud open-weight. Pin: backend "ollama", model "glm-5.3-flash:cloud". Two production files: tests/benchmark/cell_cost.py (NEW) and tests/benchmark/harness.py (876 lines; one helper + one call, anchored edit). Three new functions total.

WHY
The published scorecard needs dollars per merged story. Two cost sources already exist on disk but one is destroyed:
1. Review: app/backend_claude.py's complete() appends one JSON line per Claude call, with a "total_cost_usd" field, to <cell>/worktrees/review_token_costs.jsonl (pipeline/review.py passes the worktree's parent as cell_dir). This survives.
2. Dispatch: ClaudeCliDriver.dispatch() writes every raw stream-json line to "<log_path>.raw", i.e. <worktree>/agent.log.raw. The terminal line of each Claude run is a JSON object with "type": "result" and a "total_cost_usd" number. But the bench's _merge_pr_stub in tests/benchmark/harness.py runs `git worktree remove --force` on merge, deleting it, so every SUCCESSFUL cell loses its dispatch cost.
Local (Ollama) dispatches write no cost lines; their Claude spend is correctly 0.

WHAT TO BUILD
A) tests/benchmark/cell_cost.py (new module, stdlib only):
   - `_sum_cost_lines(path: Path, *, result_events_only: bool) -> float`: read the file line by line; skip lines that are not valid JSON or not a JSON object; when result_events_only is True skip objects whose "type" != "result"; add "total_cost_usd" only when it is an int or float (skip None, strings, bools - note bool is a subclass of int, exclude it explicitly). An unreadable file (OSError) contributes 0.0.
   - `claude_spend_usd(cell_dir) -> dict`: returns {"review_usd": float, "dispatch_usd": float, "total_usd": float}, each rounded to 6 places. review_usd sums every "review_token_costs.jsonl" found by Path(cell_dir).rglob with result_events_only=False; dispatch_usd sums every file matching rglob("*.log.raw") with result_events_only=True. A missing or empty cell_dir returns all zeros.
B) tests/benchmark/harness.py:
   - add a module-level helper `_preserve_dispatch_log(worktree, story_key) -> Path | None` placed directly ABOVE `def install_merge_stubs`: if Path(worktree)/"agent.log.raw" is a file, copy it (shutil.copy) to Path(worktree).parent / f"{story_key}.agent.log.raw" and return the destination; otherwise return None. If the destination already exists (a later merge of the same key), append the source's bytes to it rather than overwrite.
   - call it inside _merge_pr_stub. str_replace OLD (exactly once):
        _sh(["git", "push", "-q", "origin", "master"], repo)
        _sh(["git", "worktree", "remove", "--force", worktree], repo, check=False)
     NEW:
        _sh(["git", "push", "-q", "origin", "master"], repo)
        _preserve_dispatch_log(worktree, story_key)
        _sh(["git", "worktree", "remove", "--force", worktree], repo, check=False)

DO NOT CHANGE: _ci_status_stub, _open_pr_stub, MockBackend, run_groundtruth, main(), or anything in app/ or pipeline/. Do not add the spend to result.json here (a dependent story does that).

WHY
tests/benchmark/FINDINGS.md Run 1: 13 of 15 sonnet cells instantly failed at dispatch with "out_of_credits", and reviewer rate limits parked other cells; all were scored as model failures. The published run must never mix infra failures into model rates.

WHAT TO BUILD (tests/benchmark/matrix.py)
- `_needs_claude(model_cfg: dict) -> bool`: False for a mock entry; True when env PIPELINE_BACKEND_DISPATCH == "claude", or when PIPELINE_BACKEND_REVIEW is "claude" OR ABSENT (harness._set_review_backend_env defaults review to claude).
- `_probe_verdict(returncode: int, stdout: str) -> tuple[bool, str]`: pure. Unavailable (False, reason) when returncode != 0, stdout is not a JSON object, the object's "is_error" is true, or the lowercased stdout contains "out_of_credits", "rate limit", "rate_limit" or "usage limit". Otherwise (True, "").
- `claude_available() -> tuple[bool, str]`: runs ["claude", "-p", "Reply with the single word OK", "--output-format", "json"] with timeout=120, check=False, capture_output=True, text=True; a FileNotFoundError or TimeoutExpired returns (False, <reason>); otherwise returns _probe_verdict(proc.returncode, proc.stdout).
- In main()'s `_go(spec)`, after the --resume check and before run_cell: if _needs_claude(MODELS[m]) then, unless a latched-unavailable flag is already set, call claude_available(); on (False, reason) set the latch (a dict or list in main's scope - _go may run in threads, guard with threading.Lock) and print the reason once to stderr. When latched, return {"task": t, "model": m, "trial": i, "final_status": "infra_skipped", "merged": False, "groundtruth_passed": False, "groundtruth_ran": False, "timed_out": False, "elapsed_s": 0, "ticks": 0, "error": reason} WITHOUT running the cell and WITHOUT writing result.json (so a later --resume re-runs it).
- Probe once per Claude-using cell (not once per run): credits can run out mid-run.

scorecard.py: aggregate() must skip cells whose final_status == "infra_skipped" (they count in no denominator); render() adds one line after the per-model table when any were skipped: "Infra-skipped cells (not counted): N".

CUMULATIVE ARTIFACT: the scorecard's per-model table already has a "Claude $ / success" column from a sibling; keep it. Assert only your additions.

TARGET IMPLEMENTER: cloud open-weight. Pin: backend "ollama", model "glm-5.3-flash:cloud". One production file (tests/benchmark/harness.py, ~880 lines - use anchored str_replace, never line-number edits). One new helper function plus a keyword argument.

WHY
run_groundtruth() copies only `impl_src / impl_file` beside test_groundtruth.py. A Tier 3 task (API + consumer + docs) needs the ground truth to import several modules the agent changed. Without this, a sibling story's Tier 3 task cannot be graded.

WHAT TO BUILD
1. `_validate_extra_impl_files(task_name: str, value) -> list[str]` (module level, near load_task): None -> []; must be a list of non-empty str, each relative (not starting with "/"), no "\\", no ".." path component, no duplicates; otherwise raise ValueError naming the task and the bad entry.
2. load_task(): after the ecosystem block, set spec["extra_impl_files"] = _validate_extra_impl_files(name, spec.get("extra_impl_files")).
3. run_groundtruth(): add keyword parameter `extra_impl_files: tuple | list = ()`. In the pytest branch, BEFORE copying impl_file, copy each extra file from impl_src to the same relative path under scratch (mkdir parents). If any extra file is missing, return {"ran": False, "passed": False, "reason": f"no {rel} at {impl_src}"} without running pytest. For cargo and npm, a non-empty extra_impl_files returns {"ran": False, "passed": False, "reason": "extra_impl_files is only supported for pytest tasks"}.
   Also: when impl_file contains a "/" (e.g. "pkg/report.py"), create its parent dir in scratch before copying (today's code assumes a flat name).
4. main(): pass extra_impl_files=task.get("extra_impl_files", []) in the run_groundtruth call.

DO NOT CHANGE: behavior for every existing task (none declares extra_impl_files, so their grading must be byte-identical), _merge_pr_stub, _preserve_dispatch_log, the result dict.
